in_marathi.name: Chandhu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandhu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandhu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chandra', which means 'Moon'. In Hindu mythology, the moon is personified as the god, Chandrama, and is revered for his calming and nurturing influence.
